title: Q-REACH-bridge: let qnfo-social publish reach-queue posts on the already-credentialed accounts
body:
**Owner:** marketing-manager
**Trigger:** reach --run, awaiting-account on bluesky or mastodon
**Done check:** grep:ops/reach/metrics.jsonl::"social_referrals_7d"
**Prediction:** social_referrals_7d >= 10 within 336 h
**Status:** open

QNFO/qnfo-workers qnfo-social already posts a weekly Ultrastable thread (ULTRASTABLE-POSTS-1) on credentialed accounts. Add a pull of social/calendar.json event posts (kind: event) under its caps and owner-voice guard, in that repository, by PR.
